reviewable_direction.why_it_is_reviewable: The official record declares 405 ransomware-binary executions represented by raw ProcMon PML files, identifies those files by the MalwareBazaar SHA-256 rather than a class label, publishes a separate derived SPADE provenance-graph archive, and pins every artifact part by byte size and MD5.

blocking_risks_before_any_source_role: The official metadata does not declare VM reset, snapshot restore, or sandbox reinitialization between executions.
A central-directory audit must prove that at least four unique SHA-256 identifiers map to separate PML execution members without using summary.csv or class-bearing paths.
PML and DOT views of the same SHA-256 must remain one lineage group.
summary.csv and any malware-family, detector, verdict, answer, or ground-truth fields must remain physically excluded.
The raw PML artifact is a multipart object exceeding 133 GB; no acquisition plan or subset is approved.
The derived DOT archive is about 10.9 GB and cannot be substituted for raw PML without a separate source-role and evidence-level decision.
The corpus has no metadata-declared benign or null executions and cannot by itself repair class balance.
Protected-payload exact and near-duplicate exclusion remains unperformed.
Nested notices and any embedded third-party terms remain unverified.

screened_not_advanced.reason: The official description says every sample includes endpoint API-call logs, but it does not define a reset execution unit or expose a label-independent per-sample grouping key. The four top-level archives are class labels and cannot be counted as lineages.

screened_not_advanced.official_reset_declaration: The Android operating system was re-initialized before every application run.
screened_not_advanced.reason: The lineage declaration is strong, but the current official API exposes no files, byte sizes, checksums, or artifact license.

The record declares system-call traces from benign and infected apps and exposes SHA-like names, but it does not state reset semantics or provide a metadata-level one-trace-per-independent-execution contract. File count is not promoted to run count.
The official description confirms benign and ransomware Sysmon logs but declares neither four executions nor a label-independent grouping key.
The deposited artifacts are two labeled CSV feature tables, not per-execution raw endpoint evidence. Sample counts cannot repair loss of source pointers or label isolation.
The official record describes evaluation results over 78 scenarios, not source-native endpoint logs or provenance captures with recoverable evidence pointers.

verification_limitations: No publication full text, archive, archive member, source code, or payload was read under this metadata-only authorization.
Crossref verifies publication identity and the dataset citation but does not by itself prove VM reset or execution independence.
Semantic Scholar rate limiting and an absent OpenAlex exact-DOI record were logged; Crossref, DataCite, Zenodo, and DOI resolution independently verified the relevant identities.
Statistical independence, unique member mapping, pointer recoverability, nested notices, and protected-payload exclusion require separately authorized bounded audits.

evidence: Zenodo 8123115 declares 405 raw PML execution groups and 861 DOT outputs derived from those executions.
The record says PML files are named by the MalwareBazaar SHA-256, which is not a class or attack label.
The CC-BY-4.0 record is revision-pinned and every one of its 15 files has an official byte size and MD5.
Crossref verifies the matching-author ACM CSET 2023 paper and its formal citation of the REPROD concept DOI.
No Cuckoo archive was downloaded or considered, and the rejected KernelDriver class-path lineage was not reopened.
inference: REPROD is the first newly screened direction in this search that closes the metadata-level artifact gate and exposes more than four curator-declared, label-independent candidate execution groups.
The absence of a reset declaration prevents treating the 405 executions as verified independent lineages before a bounded manifest review.
The source is all-ransomware and cannot supply null or benign capacity; scientific use would be limited to supported executed-evidence examples unless paired with another separately approved source.
Metadata-level distinctness from current train, development, and test families is plausible, but payload-level overlap cannot be ruled out without hashes from a future manifest audit.
recommendation: Open a separate, metadata-only per-family candidate review for reprod_ransomware_execution_provenance_2023.
If that review passes, require a new exact bounded acquisition contract; do not download the 144.7 GB artifact under the current authority.
Any future audit must freeze SHA-256 as the label-blind grouping candidate, keep PML and derived DOT views in one lineage, and exclude summary.csv and all label-bearing fields.
Keep EN2025, TwinDroid, SILRAD, and the Android reset dataset on hold for the documented gates; do not count files, classes, traces, or scenarios as replacement lineages.
